decisions.reason: The mitred handle family remained on the website in 2024, but no results were reported, so performance against aspirations is uncertain; the slack of an established handle maker with in-house manufacturing lets it carry the line for now.
Moving from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024 signals growing commitment and satisfactory results, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The handle family is still listed but has no reported results and has gained no prominence, so the risk of a cut is moderate, yet nothing points to a clear shortfall that would force it off the market.
The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and kept its dedicated page, clearly exceeding aspirations and fitting the firm's design-led strategy.
